summary.answer: The reset connection is a conditional cross-phase replacement, not an atomic respawn cleanup. It disables offhands and sets a reset flag before a native-use wait; early return or receiver cancellation can bypass its clear/reenable tail. Spawn only conditionally initializes missing inventory in its own callback, and the world flag barrier is not a child-thread join. Old captured numeric IDs and object references therefore retain explicit cross-reset identity/scheduling gaps.
